title: Non-Weird Vertical Dispenser and Dropper
description: If you thought the vertical dispensers and droppers looked weird, you aren't alone, so I took this into my own hands.
body:
This pack makes vertical dispensers and droppers similar too the vertical crafter. Since it doesn't have an rotation when facing up, I used blockstates to make it rotate randomly.

This only changes blockstates, so custom textures and/or models should work.
